en: Now that you got a more than solid
HTMX foundation,
it's time to dive a bit deeper. And in this
section, we'll dive deeper by exploring how
you can control and configure
the requests and responses that are sent and
handled by HTMX.
I mean, of course, we did already control
and configure those requests and work with
those responses in the previous sections.
But in this section, we'll dive a bit deeper
and explore even more control options.
Specifically, we'll have a look at how you
can
attach but also remove data to and from
outgoing requests.
We'll explore how you can synchronize
multiple requests that might be sent at the
same time and how you can make sure that
just the requests you want to get sent are
being sent.
We'll also explore how you can set HTMX
headers on the response that's sent back
from the backend to change the behavior of
HTMX on the frontend, which is a pretty
exciting and useful feature.
And we'll explore how you can send multiple
different responses from one and the same
request and make sure that different things
happen in the HTMX-controlled frontend.
